original: śrīmannārāyaṇākāramaṣṭākṣaramahāśayam | svamātrānubhavātsiddhamātmabodhaṃ hariṃ bhaje || oṃ vāṅme manasīti śāntiḥ ||
analyzed: śrīmat nārāyaṇa ākāram aṣṭa akṣara mahā āśayam sva mātra anubhavāt siddham ātma bodham harim bhaje om vāc me manasi iti śāntiḥ

original: ||prathamo'dyāya:||
analyzed: prathama udyāya

original: oṃ pratyagānandaṃ brahmapuruṣaṃ praṇavasvarūpaṃ akāro ukāra makāra iti tryakṣaraṃ praṇavaṃ tadetadomiti | yamuktvā mucyate yogī janmasaṃsārabandhanāt | oṃ namonārāyaṇāya śaṅkhacakragadādharāya tasmāt oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantropāsako vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ gamiṣyati | || 1||
analyzed: om pratyagānandam brahma puruṣam praṇava svarūpam akāraḥ ukāra makāraḥ iti tri akṣaram praṇavam tat etat om iti yam uktvā mucyate yogī janma saṃsāra bandhanāt om namaḥ nārāyaṇāya śaṅkha cakra gadā dharāya tasmāt om namaḥ nārāyaṇāya iti mantra upāsakaḥ vaikuṇṭha bhavanam gamiṣyati

original: atha yadidaṃ brahmapuraṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ tasmāttaḍitābhamātraṃ dīpavatprakāśam ||2||
analyzed: atha yat idam brahmapuram puṇḍarīkam tasmāt taḍit ābha mātram dīpa vat prakāśam

original: brahmaṇyo devakīputro brahmaṇyo madhusūdanaḥ | brahmaṇyaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo brahmaṇyo viṣṇuracyutaḥ ||3||
analyzed: brahmaṇyaḥ devakīputraḥ brahmaṇyaḥ madhusūdanaḥ brahmaṇyaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ brahmaṇyaḥ viṣṇuḥ acyutaḥ

original: sarvabhūtasthamekaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kāraṇapuruṣamakāraṇaṃ paraṃ brahmom ||4||
analyzed: sarva bhūta stham ekam nārāyaṇam kāraṇa puruṣam akāraṇam param brahma om

original: śokamohavinirmukto viṣṇuṃ dhyāyanna sīdati | dvaitādvaitamabhayaṃ bhavati mṛtyoḥ sa mṛtyumāpnoti ya iha nāneva paśyati ||5||
analyzed: śoka moha vinirmuktaḥ viṣṇum dhyāyan na sīdati dvaita advaitam abhayam bhavati mṛtyoḥ sa mṛtyum āpnoti yaḥ iha nānā iva paśyati 5

original: hṛtpadmamadhye sarvaṃ yattatprajñāne pratiṣṭhitam | prajñānetro lokaḥ prajñā pratiṣṭhā prajñānaṃ brahma ||6||
analyzed: hṛd padma madhye sarvam yat tat prajñāne pratiṣṭhitam prajñā netraḥ lokaḥ prajñā pratiṣṭhā prajñānam brahma

original: sa etena prajñenātmanāsmāllokādutkramyāmuṣminsvarge loke sarvānkāmānāptvā'mṛtaḥ samabhavadamṛtaḥ samabhavat ||7||
analyzed: saḥ etena prajñena ātmanā asmāt lokāt utkramya amuṣmin svarge loke sarvān kāmān āptvā amṛtaḥ samabhavat amṛtaḥ samabhavat

original: yatra jyotirajasraṃ yasmiṃlloke'bhyarhitamaṃ tasminmāṃ dehi svamānamṛte loke akṣate acyute loke akṣate amṛtatvaṃ ca gacchatyoṃ namaḥ || 8||
analyzed: yatra jyotiḥ ajasram yasmin loka ibhyarhitamam tasmin mām dehi sva mānam ṛte loke akṣate acyute loke akṣate amṛta tvam ca gacchati om namaḥ

original: ||dvitīyo'dyāya:||
analyzed: dvitīya udyāya

original: pragalitanijamāyo'haṃ nistuladṛśirūpavastumātro'ham | astamitāhanto'haṃ pragalitajagadīśajīvabhedo'ham || 1||
analyzed: pragalita nija māyā uham nistula dṛśi rūpa vastu mātra ūham astamita ahantā ūham pragalita jagadīśa jīva bheda ūham

original: pratyagabhinnaparo'haṃ vidhvastāśeṣavidhiniṣedho'ham | samudastāśramito'haṃ pravitatasukhapūrṇasaṃvidevāham || 2||
analyzed: pratyak abhinna paraḥ ūham vidhvasta aśeṣa vidhi niṣedhaḥ ūham samudasta āśramita ūham pravitata sukha pūrṇa saṃvid eva aham

original: sākṣyahamanapekṣo'haṃ nijamahimni saṃsthito'hamacalo'ham | ajaro'hamavyayo'haṃ pakṣavipakṣādibhedavidhuro'ham || 3||
analyzed: sākṣī aham anapekṣā ūham nija mahimni saṃsthitaḥ ūham acalaḥ ūham ajaraḥ ūham avyayaḥ ūham pakṣa vipakṣa ādi bheda vidhuraḥ ūham

original: avabodhaikaraso'haṃ mokṣānandaikasindhurevāham | sūkṣmo'hamakṣaro'haṃ vigalitaguṇajālakevalātmā'ham || 4||
analyzed: avabodha eka rasaḥ uham mokṣa ānanda eka sindhuḥ eva aham sūkṣmaḥ ūham akṣaraḥ ham vigalita guṇa jāla kevala ātmā aham

original: nistraiguṇyapado'haṃ kukṣisthānekalokakalano'ham | kūṭasthacetano'haṃ niṣkriyadhāmāhamapratarkyo'ham || 5||
analyzed: nistraiguṇya padā ūham kukṣi stha aneka loka kalanā ūham kūṭastha cetanā ūham niṣkriya dhāmā aham apratarkyā ūham

original: eko'hamavikalo'haṃ nirmalanirvāṇamūrtirevāham | niravayo'hamajo'haṃ kevalasanmātrasārabhūto'ham || 6||
analyzed: ekaḥ aham avika loham nirmala nirvāṇa mūrtiḥ eva aham niravayaḥ aham aja uham kevala sanmātra sāra bhūta ūham

original: niravadhinijabodho'haṃ śubhatarabhāvo'hamaprabhedyo'ham | vibhurahamanavadyo'haṃ niravadhiniḥsīmatattvamātro'ham || 7||
analyzed: niravadhi nija bodha ūham śubhatara bhāvaḥ ūham aprabhedya ūham vibhuḥ aham anavadyā uham niravadhi niḥsīma tattva mātrā ūham

original: vedyo'hamagamāstairārādhya: sakalabhuvanahṛdyo'ham | paramānandaghano'ham paramānandaikabhūmarūpo'ham || 8||
analyzed: vedyaḥ aham agamāḥ taiḥ ārādhya sakala bhuvana hṛdyaḥ uham parama ānanda ghanaḥ uham parama ānanda eka bhūma rūpaḥ uham

original: śuddho'hamadvayo'haṃ santatabhāvo'hamādiśūnyo'ham | śamitāntatritayo'haṃ baddho mukto'hamadbhutātmāham || 9||
analyzed: śuddhaḥ ham advayaḥ uham santata bhāvaḥ ham ādi śūnyaḥ ham śamita anta tritayā uham baddhaḥ muktaḥ uham adbhuta ātmā aham

original: śuddho'hamāntaro'haṃ śāśvatavijñānasamarasātmāham | śodhitaparatattvo'haṃ bodhānandaikamūrtirevāham || 10||
analyzed: śuddhaḥ aham āntaraḥ ham śāśvata vijñāna sama rasa ātmā aham śodhita para tattvaḥ ūham bodha ānanda eka mūrtiḥ eva aham 10

original: vivekayuktibuddhyāhaṃ jānāmyātmānamadvayam | tathāpi bandhamokṣādivyavahāraḥ pratīyate || 11||
analyzed: viveka yukti buddhyā aham jānāmi ātmānam advayam tathā api bandha mokṣa ādi vyavahāraḥ pratīyate 11

original: nivṛtto'pi prapañco me satyavadbhāti sarvadā | sarpādau rajjusatteva brahmasattaiva kevalam || 12||
analyzed: nivṛttaḥ api prapañcaḥ me satya vat bhāti sarvadā sarpa ādau rajju sattā iva brahma sattā eva kevalam

original: prapañcādhārarūpeṇa vartate'to jaganna hi | yathekṣurasasaṃvyāptā śarkarā vartate tathā | || 13||
analyzed: prapañca ādhāra rūpeṇa vartata itas jagat na hi yathā ikṣu rasa saṃvyāptā śarkarā vartate tathā

original: advayabrahmarūpeṇa vyāpto'haṃ vai jagattrayam | brahmādikīṭaparyantāḥ prāṇino mayi kalpitāḥ || 14||
analyzed: advaya brahma rūpeṇa vyāptaḥ aham vai jagattrayam brahma ādi kīṭa paryantāḥ prāṇinaḥ mayi kalpitāḥ

original: budbudādivikārāntastaraṅgaḥ sāgare yathā | taraṅgasthaṃ dravaṃ sindhurna vāñchati yathā tathā || 15||
analyzed: budbuda ādi vikāra antaḥ taraṅgaḥ sāgare yathā taraṅga stham dravam sindhuḥ na vāñchati yathā tathā

original: viṣayānandavāñchā me mā bhūdānandarūpataḥ| dāridryāśā yathā nāsti saṃpannasya tathā mama || 16||
analyzed: viṣaya ānanda vāñchā me mā bhūt ānanda rūpataḥ dāridrya āśā yathā nā asti saṃpannasya tathā mama

original: brahmānande nimagnasya viṣayāśā na tadbhavet | viṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā'mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣaṃ tyajati buddhimān || 17||
analyzed: brahma ānande nimagnasya viṣaya āśā na tat bhavet viṣam dṛṣṭvā amṛtam dṛṣṭvā viṣam tyajati buddhimān

original: ātmānamapi dṛṣṭvāhamanātmānaṃ tyajāmyaham | ghaṭāvabhāsako bhānurghaṭanāśe na naśyati || 18||
analyzed: ātmānam api dṛṣṭvā aham anātmānam tyajāmi aham ghaṭa avabhāsakaḥ bhānuḥ ghaṭa nāśe na naśyati

original: dehāvabhāsakaḥ sākṣī dehanāśe na naśyati | na me bandho na me muktirna me śāstraṃ na me guruḥ || 19||
analyzed: deha avabhāsakaḥ sākṣī deha nāśe na naśyati na me bandhaḥ na me muktiḥ na me śāstram na me guruḥ

original: māyāmātravikāsatvānmāyātīto'hamadvayaḥ | prāṇāścalantu taddharmaiḥ kāmairvā hanyatāṃ manaḥ || 20||
analyzed: māyā mātra vikāsa tvāt māyā atītaḥ aham advayaḥ prāṇāḥ calantu tad dharmaiḥ kāmaiḥ vā hanyatām manaḥ

original: ānandabuddhipūrṇasya mama duḥkhaṃ kathaṃ bhavet | ātmānamañjasā vedmi kvāpyajñānaṃ palāyitam || 21||
analyzed: ānanda buddhi pūrṇasya mama duḥkham katham bhavet ātmānam añjasā vedmi kvāpi ajñānam palāyitam

original: kartṛtvamadya me naṣṭaṃ kartavyaṃ vāpi na kvacit | brāhmaṇyaṃ kulagotre ca nāmasaundaryajātayaḥ || 22||
analyzed: kartṛ tvam adya me naṣṭam kartavyam vā api na kvacid brāhmaṇyam kula gotre ca nāma saundarya jātayaḥ

original: sthūladehagatā ete sthūlādbhinnasya me nahi | kṣutpipāsāndhyabādhiryakāma krodhādayo'khilāḥ || 23||
analyzed: sthūla deha gatāḥ ete sthūlāt bhinnasya me nahi kṣudh pipāsā āndhya bādhirya kāma krodha ādayaḥ ukhilāḥ 23

original: liṅgadehagatā ete hyaliṅgasya na santi hi | jaḍatvapriyamodatvadharmāḥ kāraṇadehagāḥ || 24||
analyzed: liṅga deha gatāḥ ete hi aliṅgasya na santi hi jaḍa tva priya moda tva dharmāḥ kāraṇa deha gāḥ

original: na santi mama nityasya nirvikārasvarūpiṇaḥ| ulūkasya yathā bhānurandhakāraḥ pratīyate || 25||
analyzed: na santi mama nityasya nirvikāra svarūpiṇaḥ ulūkasya yathā bhānuḥ andhakāraḥ pratīyate 25

original: svaprakāśe parānande tamo mūḍhasya jāyate | cakṣurdṛṣṭinirodhe'bhraiḥ sūryo nāstīti manyate || 26||
analyzed: sva prakāśe para ānande tamaḥ mūḍhasya jāyate cakṣuḥ dṛṣṭi nirodha ibhraiḥ sūryaḥ nā asti iti manyate

original: tathā'jñānāvṛto dehī brahma nāstīti manyate | yathāmṛtaṃ viṣādbhinnaṃ viṣadoṣairna lipyate || 27||
analyzed: tathā ajñāna āvṛtaḥ dehī brahma nā asti iti manyate yathā amṛtam viṣāt bhinnam viṣa doṣaiḥ na lipyate

original: na spṛśāmi jaḍādbhinno jaḍadoṣān prakāśataḥ | svalpāpi dīpakaṇikā bahulaṃ nāśayettamaḥ || 28||
analyzed: na spṛśāmi jaḍāt bhinnaḥ jaḍa doṣān prakāśataḥ su alpā api dīpa kaṇikā bahulam nāśayet tamaḥ

original: svalpo'pi bodho nibiḍe bahulaṃ nāśayettamaḥ | kālatraye yathā sarpo rajjau nāsti tathā mayi || 29||
analyzed: su alpaḥ api bodhaḥ nibiḍe bahulam nāśayet tamaḥ kāla traye yathā sarpaḥ rajjau nā asti tathā mayi

original: ahaṅkārādidehāntaṃ jagannāstyahamadvayaḥ | cidrūpatvānna me jāḍyaṃ satyatvānnānṛtaṃ mama || 30||
analyzed: ahaṅkāra ādi deha antam jagat na asti aham advayaḥ cit rūpa tvāt na me jāḍyam satya tvāt na anṛtam mama

original: ānandatvānna me duḥkhamajñānādbhāti satyavat | ātmaprabodhopaniṣa muhūrtamupāsitvā na sa punarāvartate | na sa punarāvartata ityupaniṣat || 31||
analyzed: ānanda tvāt na me duḥkham ajñānāt bhāti satya vat muhūrtam upāsitvā na sa punar āvartate na sa punar āvartate iti upaniṣad

original: oṃ vāṅme manasīti śāntiḥ ||
analyzed: om vāc me manasi iti śāntiḥ
